# Planetary artwork

Source: [Solar System Scope / INOVE](https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/).
License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The source maps are based on NASA elevation and imagery data, with color adjustments and fictional fill in unmapped regions. These are visualisation maps, not scientific measurements.

The following source maps were adapted into lit orthographic sphere sprites, with resampling, cloud compositing on Earth, restrained atmospheric rim lighting, and WebP compression:

| Sprite | Original map |
|---|---|
| Moon | 8k_moon.jpg |
| Earth | 8k_earth_daymap.jpg + 8k_earth_clouds.jpg |
| Mars | 8k_mars.jpg |
| Mercury | 8k_mercury.jpg |
| Venus | 4k_venus_atmosphere.jpg |
| Jupiter | 8k_jupiter.jpg |
| Saturn | 8k_saturn.jpg |
| Uranus | 2k_uranus.jpg |
| Neptune | 2k_neptune.jpg |
| Sun | 8k_sun.jpg |

Original download pattern: `https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/<filename>`.
The Sun's corona and Saturn's drawn rings are original illustrative effects. They are not photographs.

The rendered sprites retain the CC BY 4.0 attribution above. Keep this credit when redistributing the project.
